popia.title: Ubumfihlo Bakho, Amalungelo Akho
popia.intro: IVulindlela izibophezele ekuvikeleni imininingwane yakho. Silandela uMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kwezinhlelo Zemininingwane (POPIA).

who_we_are.title: 1. Singobani
who_we_are.content: IVulindlela iyiNhlangano Enomthwalo. Isikhulu sethu semininingwane singatholakala ku-privacy@vulindlela.org.za.

what_we_collect.title: 2. Esikuqoqayo
what_we_collect.content: Siqoqa kuphela lokho esikudingayo: igama lakho, inombolo yomakhalekhukhwini, ilokishi/idolobha, amakhono, nolimi olukhethayo. Asikubuzi ngezinombolo ze-ID noma imininingwane yasebhange.

why_we_collect.title: 3. Kungani sikuqoqa
why_we_collect.content: Ukukuxhumanisa namathuba, ukuqinisekisa abaqashi, nokukugcina uphephile emikhubeni yokukhwabanisa (scams).

who_sees_it.title: 4. Ubani obona imininingwane yakho
who_sees_it.content: Abaqashi babona kuphela lokho okhetha ukukwabelana nabo. Asilokothi sithengise imininingwane yakho.

protection.title: 5. Siyivikela kanjani
protection.content: Imininingwane yakho ifihliwe (encrypted) futhi igcinwe ngokuphepha.

rights.title: 6. Amalungelo Akho
rights.content: Ungabona, ushintshe, noma ususe imininingwane yakho noma nini. Ungakwazi futhi ukukhononda ku-Information Regulator.

under_18.title: 7. Uma ungaphansi kweminyaka engu-18
under_18.content: Abasebenzisi abaneminyaka engu-15–17 badinga imvume yomzali noma umbheki nge-OTP.

camera.title: 8. Ikhamera Nokusetshenziswa Kwezandla
camera.content: Uma usebenzisa izimpawu zezandla (gestures), ividiyo icutshungulwa kudivayisi yakho kuphela futhi ayilokothi igcinwe.

popia.consent_processing: Ngiyavuma ukuthi iVulindlela icubungule imininingwane yami ukuze isebenzise i-akhawunti yami. (Kudingekile)
popia.consent_employer: Ngiyavuma ukwabelana ngephrofayili yami nabaqashi abaqinisekisiwe. (Ngokuzithandela)

shield.title: Isihlangu se-Vulindlela
shield.detector_desc: Namathisela uhlu lwemisebenzi noma umlayezo ngezansi ukuze uhlole izimpawu eziyingozi.

accessibility.title: Ukufinyeleleka
accessibility.question: Ingabe udinga ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lusebenze ngendlela ehlukile kuwe?
